verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a product-engineering work-tracking platform with GitHub integration and agent features, so AI-assisted diff explanation is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows it breaking a code diff into focused sections or explaining what changed and why. The overlapping-PR detection, GitHub integration and Docs suggestion mode are adjacent features and do not count as AI diff walkthroughs.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
